item.title: Kerry IFA calls Irish MEPs in favour of Mercosur deal "weaklings"
item.description: The chairperson of Kerry IFA is calling on the government and Irish MEPs to lobby strongly against the Mercosur trade deal. Jason Fleming says not enough Irish MEPs are against the deal, describing the others as 'weaklings'. Mercosur, or the Southern Common Market, is an economic and political bloc in South America. item.title: Weather and sea conditions hamper efforts to salvage French fishing trawler aground near Dingle
item.description: Weather and sea conditions have hampered efforts to assess a fishing trawler gone aground near Dingle. The 14 people onboard has to rescued by the Coast Guard on Sunday when the nearly 28-metre French vessel was blown onto the rocks at Binn Bán. The Fastnet is now stuck at the mouth of Dingle harbour, west of Dingle lighthouse. item.title: Passengers urged to allow plenty of time as over 20,000 expected through Kerry Airport over Christmas
item.description: Passengers travelling through Kerry Airport over the festive period are being encouraged to allow plenty of time before their flights. The advice comes as over 20,00 people are expected to fly through the Farranfore airport over Christmas. Staff at the airport will handle 146 flights between today and December 30th, an over 6% increase in passenger traffic compared to last year. item.title: Cork Airport expects 164,000 passengers over festive season
item.description: Cork Airport is expecting 164,000 passengers between now and the 6th of January. That’s up 7% compared to the same period last year. Passengers arriving over the coming days will be greeted by Christmas choirs and musicians, which will continue to perform on the Arrivals stage until 23rd of December. Advertisement Managing Director at Cork Airport, Niall McCarthy, said that they take great pride in their service every season, but particularly at Christmas 2025 will be the airport’s busiest year

item.title: High Court dismisses Kerry TDs legal challenge over super junior ministers cabinet meetings attendance
item.description: Kerry Sinn Féin TD Pa Daly and People Before Profit TD Paul Murphy have lost their legal challenges over the attendance of super junior ministers at cabinet meetings. As it stands, the government has four super junior ministers who attend cabinet meetings, but do not have voting rights. The Opposition TDs argued the attendance of super juniors at cabinet breached a constitutional cap on the number of members of government. item.title: McPhail departs Rovers
item.description: Shamrock Rovers have confirmed that Stephen McPhail has resigned as the club's sporting director. The former Republic of Ireland international had been in the job for nine years. In his time at Tallaght Stadium, Rovers have claimed five Men's Premier Division titles, and reached the knockout stages of last season's Conference League. Advertisement

item.description: Kate O'Connor has been crowned the Irish Times Sport Ireland Sportswoman of the Year for 2025. item.title: Two Kerry schools to benefit from safe routes to school programme
item.description: Two Kerry schools have been allocated funding to improve walking and cycling infrastructure. They’re among 105 primary and secondary schools nationwide to receive funding, under the latest round of the Safe Routes to School (SRTS) Programme. It’s part of up to €20 million in funding announced by Transport Minister, Darragh O’Brien.
